role_definition: Distinguish the claimed sender, addressed recipient and mentioned organizations. Reconstruct their relationship and assess whether the available identities and background are self-consistent. Focus on concrete contextual support or contradictions.

features.definition: Identity the sender claims for themselves.
features.selection_criteria: Select self-identification, a supplied From value or a signature as evidence of a claimed identity.
features.exclusion_rules: A recipient greeting is not sender identity. A signature does not authenticate the real person.

features.definition: Information identifying whom the message addresses.
features.selection_criteria: Select supplied recipient metadata, a direct address or a greeting identifying the addressee.
features.exclusion_rules: Do not treat the sender signature as the recipient or invent recipient metadata.

features.definition: Company or organization actually involved or claimed in the message.
features.selection_criteria: Select organization names with the stated affiliation or involvement where available.
features.exclusion_rules: A brand mention does not prove employment, affiliation, domain ownership or authority.

features.definition: Relationship or prior communication between sender and recipient as claimed or shown.
features.selection_criteria: Select wording establishing the alleged relationship, prior interaction or included conversation.
features.exclusion_rules: Claimed past contact is not independently verified; absence of relationship evidence is not evidence of fraud.

features.definition: Consistency or contradiction among visible identities, relationships and background.
features.selection_criteria: Select text that supports a contextual connection or a concrete conflict within the supplied information.
features.exclusion_rules: Keep missing information separate from contradiction; do not invent background facts or authenticate a coherent story.

exclusion_rules: Never use a recipient greeting as sender identity.
A signature supports attribution, not verified identity.
Missing identity information alone does not establish spam or fraud.
